Strategy: Keep the winning band edges but strengthen the reward to thirty, testing whether a bigger bonus for the twenty-eight to forty-two window helps more. It may help by committing harder to the good band, but may fail if the stronger bonus overrides tight fits too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (30 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (25 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
